issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The script reads no files, uses no network, pastes no coordinates and uses no labels. The new phase computes its answer: it moves one of the 8 smallest circles to the grid point with the most free space, then re-polishes and re-solves the LP for the radii.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. A new state is accepted only if its radii come from _lp_radii(), and the final 1e-10 shrink is kept. The time limits (110 s, then 170 s) end well under the ~240 s safety margin.

Both loops stop on the clock, so the result depends on machine speed and will not repeat exactly even though the seed is fixed. The search phase was also cut from 150 s to 110 s, so any gain from the new phase is offset by less search time.

Recomputed z = 0: candidate -2.636 vs incumbent -2.6360, one run each. With only one run per side the spread can't be estimated. The values are rounded to 3 decimals, which hides any real difference below 1e-3. The provisional 'reject' agrees with the numbers: there's no evidence of improvement.
